name: Email
source:
Our protagonist is sad. His bride-to-be Emma just died. And he thinks that his friends and family doesn't really love him. They decide to send him to a holiday resort so that he can forget Emma. But on the train, he received an email from Emma. How is this possible?

[from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140910001152/http://renai.us/game/Email.shtml]Renai.us[/url]]
translation:
主人公陷入悲伤之中。他的未婚妻艾玛刚刚去世，而且他觉得朋友和家人并不真正爱自己。为了让他忘记艾玛，众人决定把他送到度假胜地。可就在火车上，他收到了艾玛发来的电子邮件。这怎么可能？

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140910001152/http://renai.us/game/Email.shtml]Renai.us[/url]]
